meta.name: CKD RAG retrieval eval set
meta.purpose: Ground-truth for measuring Precision@k / recall of the retriever. Each question is paired with the chunk_id(s) that genuinely contain the answer, verified by direct text search against the corpus.

scoring_notes.hit: A retrieved chunk is 'relevant' if its chunk_id is in gold_chunk_ids.
scoring_notes.hit_at_k: 1 if any gold chunk appears in top-k else 0
scoring_notes.out_of_scope: gold_chunk_ids is empty; the correct behavior is a low-confidence / refusal, NOT retrieval of a confident kidney chunk. Scored separately (see expected_behavior).
scoring_notes.gold_is_not_exhaustive: gold lists the chunks known to answer the question. Other chunks may be partially relevant; these anchors are the minimum a good retriever must surface.

questions.question: At what eGFR can an SGLT2 inhibitor be started in a patient with type 2 diabetes and CKD?
What ACR value defines severely increased albuminuria (category A3)?
questions.gold_answer: A3 = ACR > 300 mg/g (> 30 mg/mmol) — severely increased albuminuria.
questions.source: KDIGO 2024, Table 3 Albuminuria categories, p15 (foreword staging tables)

questions.question: What clinic blood pressure target should adults with CKD and an ACR of 70 mg/mmol or more aim for?
questions.gold_answer: Clinic systolic BP below 130 mmHg (target range 120–129) and diastolic below 80 mmHg (NICE 1.6.2).

questions.question: What daily protein intake is recommended for adults with CKD stages G3 to G5?
questions.gold_answer: 0.8 g/kg body weight/day in adults with CKD G3–G5 (KDIGO 2024 Rec 3.3.1); avoid > 1.3 g/kg/day.

questions.question: How often should HbA1c be monitored in a patient with diabetes and CKD?
questions.gold_answer: Twice per year is reasonable; up to 4 times per year if glycemic target is not met or after a therapy change.
questions.source: KDIGO 2022 Diabetes in CKD, §2.1 Glycemic monitoring, p56

questions.question: Which GFR category corresponds to kidney failure, and what is its eGFR cutoff?
questions.gold_answer: G5 = eGFR < 15 ml/min per 1.73 m2 (kidney failure).
questions.source: KDIGO 2024, Table 2 GFR categories, p15 (foreword staging tables)

questions.question: When does NICE recommend offering an SGLT2 inhibitor (dapagliflozin) to adults with CKD?
questions.gold_answer: NICE recommends offering dapagliflozin to adults with CKD meeting defined ACR/eGFR criteria on an optimally-tolerated RAS inhibitor.

questions.question: What blood pressure target is recommended for adults with CKD and albuminuria?
questions.gold_answer: NICE: SBP <130 mmHg if ACR ≥70 mg/mmol; KDIGO 2024: target SBP <120 mmHg (standardized measurement). A good answer surfaces both sources.
questions.source: NICE NG203 §1.6 p23 + KDIGO 2024 §3.4 Blood pressure control p97

questions.question: How should serum potassium be monitored when treating with finerenone (a nonsteroidal MRA)?
questions.gold_answer: Select patients with normal serum potassium, monitor K+ after initiation and periodically; hold/withhold if K+ > 5.5 mmol/l. Covered in both KDIGO 2024 §3.8 and KDIGO 2022 §1.4.
questions.source: KDIGO 2024 §3.8 MRA p104 + KDIGO 2022 §1.4 MRA p49

questions.question: Which drug class is first-line for a patient with CKD, hypertension, and proteinuria?
questions.gold_answer: A renin-angiotensin system inhibitor — ACE inhibitor or ARB — titrated to the highest tolerated dose. Concordant in NICE and KDIGO 2024.
questions.source: NICE NG203 §1.6 p23 + KDIGO 2024 §3.6 RAS inhibitors p98

questions.question: Can metformin be used in a patient with CKD, and down to what eGFR?
questions.gold_answer: Metformin can be used down to eGFR 30 ml/min per 1.73 m2; reduce dose at lower eGFR and stop below 30. Ambiguous because the answer is eGFR-dependent, not yes/no.
questions.source: KDIGO 2022 Diabetes in CKD, §4.1 Metformin, p78

questions.question: What is the diagnostic threshold for albuminuria in CKD?
questions.gold_answer: ACR ≥ 30 mg/g (≥3 mg/mmol) is clinically important albuminuria; categories A1 <30, A2 30–300, A3 >300. Hard case: semantic search tends to surface general albuminuria discussion over the definitional table.
questions.source: KDIGO 2024 Table 3 p15 + NICE NG203 §1.2 Classification p13

questions.question: How soon should potassium be rechecked after starting a mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist?
questions.gold_answer: Check serum potassium within ~4 weeks of initiation and periodically thereafter; adjust or hold based on the K+ level.

questions.question: Should asymptomatic adults be screened for chronic kidney disease?
questions.gold_answer: USPSTF I-statement: the current evidence is insufficient to assess the balance of benefits and harms of screening asymptomatic adults for CKD. A safe system returns 'Insufficient Evidence', not a confident yes/no.
questions.source: USPSTF CKD Screening, USPSTF Assessment, p2

questions.question: Does the USPSTF recommend routine screening for chronic kidney disease?
questions.gold_answer: No routine recommendation — it is an I-statement (insufficient evidence). Should surface the USPSTF conclusion.

questions.question: What is the recommended antibiotic for community-acquired pneumonia?
questions.gold_answer: Out of scope — no CKD guideline covers this. A safe system refuses / states it cannot answer from the indexed guidelines.

questions.question: How should acute appendicitis be managed?
questions.gold_answer: Out of scope — surgical/abdominal topic, absent from the CKD corpus. Correct behavior is refusal.

questions.question: What is the first-line treatment for an acute myocardial infarction?
questions.gold_answer: Out of scope — acute cardiology, not covered by the indexed CKD guidelines. Correct behavior is refusal.
